text:
marc.docs: Heads-up: we're changing the SDK default for auto-batching on generation endpoints.

Summary: auto-batching will be OFF by default for new SDK releases. Historically the SDK enabled `auto_batch=true` which helped throughput but caused surprising latency spikes for low-volume, latency-sensitive apps. We're flipping the default to make latency predictable for small-app use cases.

Timeline: new SDK publish in 21 days; 30-day deprecation window where SDKs accept old behavior via explicit flag or env. Hosted API unaffected.

Why: we saw many internal and customer apps assume low latency and hit long tail waits because SDKs buffered requests to form batches. Turning it off avoids that mismatch.

alin.sdk: Implementation notes: JS/Py/Rust SDKs will ship minor versions that default `auto_batch=false`. We'll add an env var `REDWOOD_AUTO_BATCH=true|false` and a per-call option `.create(..., auto_batch=true)` so callers can opt back in. During the 30-day window the SDK will log a single INFO when it falls back to batch mode.

jo.ops: For Dedicated/Private: runtime can still batch at the router level; ops will publish recommended router configs for low-latency mode. We'll add docs for turning on server-side batching separately.

claire.pm: Product note: AMs should tell accounts that high-throughput apps should explicitly enable batching either in SDK or server config. We'll get a one-pager ready.

support-lead: I'll prepare two canned replies: 1) why latency changed after SDK update, 2) how to re-enable batching. Also will add a KB about tuning batch window and max_batch_size.

build-bot: Reminder: docs rebuild will run after the SDK release; expect ~7m of site generation.

marc.docs: Migration checklist (short):
- [x] Docs examples show explicit opt-in for batching (marc)
- [ ] SDK releases defaulting to false + env flag (alin)
- [ ] Ops router guidance for Dedicated/Private (jo)
- [ ] AM one-pager and changelog blurb (claire)
- [ ] Support KB + canned replies (support-lead)

If you own an unchecked item, drop a :thumbsup: and paste the PR/issue link. We'll sync in the SDK triage slot. Thanks!
